125// std::array::at() is not constexpr until C++17; constexpr lookup tables need
126// operator[] on C++11/14.
127#if __cplusplus >= 201703L
128#define LUMEX_CRC_ARRAY_REF(table, index) \
129 (table).at (static_cast<std::size_t> (index))
130#else
131#define LUMEX_CRC_ARRAY_REF(table, index) \
132 (table)[static_cast<std::size_t> (index)]

135LUMEX_CONST_NUM int kMaxCrcBitWidth = 64;
136LUMEX_CONST_NUM int kBitsPerByte = 8;
137LUMEX_CONST_NUM std::size_t kTableByteCount = 256U;
138LUMEX_CONST_NUM std::uint8_t kByteMaskU8 = 0xFFU;
139
140#if __cplusplus >= 201402L
141template <typename Spec>
142LUMEX_CONSTEXPR_FUNCTION void
143ValidateSpec () LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
144{
145 LUMEX_STATIC_ASSERT_MSG (Spec::kWidth > 0 && Spec::kWidth <= kMaxCrcBitWidth,
146 "Spec::kWidth must be 1..64");
147 LUMEX_STATIC_ASSERT_MSG (
148 std::numeric_limits<typename Spec::ValueType>::is_integer,
149 "Spec::ValueType must be an integer type");
150 LUMEX_STATIC_ASSERT_MSG (
151 std::numeric_limits<typename Spec::ValueType>::digits >= Spec::kWidth,
152 "Spec::ValueType must hold at least kWidth bits");
153}
154#else
155template <typename Spec>
156inline void
157ValidateSpec () LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
158{
159 struct validator_t
160 {
161 LUMEX_STATIC_ASSERT_MSG (Spec::kWidth > 0
162 && Spec::kWidth <= kMaxCrcBitWidth,
163 "Spec::kWidth must be 1..64");
164 LUMEX_STATIC_ASSERT_MSG (
165 std::numeric_limits<typename Spec::ValueType>::is_integer,
166 "Spec::ValueType must be an integer type");
167 LUMEX_STATIC_ASSERT_MSG (
168 std::numeric_limits<typename Spec::ValueType>::digits >= Spec::kWidth,
169 "Spec::ValueType must hold at least kWidth bits");
170 };
171 (void)sizeof (validator_t);
172}
173#endif

175// Partial specialization: avoid (1u64 << Width) when Width == digits(uint64_t)
176// (UB / -Wshift).
177template <int Width, typename Enable = void> struct mask_impl_t
178{
179 static LUMEX_CRC_DETAIL_CONSTEXPR std::uint64_t
180 Value () LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
181 {
182 return (std::uint64_t{ 1 } << static_cast<unsigned> (Width))
183 - std::uint64_t{ 1 };
184 }
185};
186
187template <int Width>
188struct mask_impl_t<
189 Width,
190 typename std::enable_if<
191 Width == std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::digits, void>::type>
192{
193 static LUMEX_CRC_DETAIL_CONSTEXPR std::uint64_t
194 Value () LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
195 {
196 return ~std::uint64_t{};
197 }
198};
199
200template <int Width>
201LUMEX_CRC_DETAIL_CONSTEXPR std::uint64_t
202Mask () LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
203{
204 LUMEX_STATIC_ASSERT_MSG (Width > 0 && Width <= kMaxCrcBitWidth,
205 "CRC width must be in 1..64");
206 return mask_impl_t<Width>::Value ();
207}
208
209// NOLINTBEGIN(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters) - signatures match RevEng
210// notation (data, width / index, poly)
211LUMEX_CRC_DETAIL_CONSTEXPR std::uint64_t
212Reflect (std::uint64_t data, int width) LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
213{
214 std::uint64_t reflected = 0;
215 for (int bitIndex = 0; bitIndex < width; ++bitIndex)
216 if (((data >> bitIndex) & 1U) != 0U)
217 reflected |= (std::uint64_t{ 1 } << (width - 1 - bitIndex));
218 return reflected;
219}
220
221template <int Width>
222LUMEX_CRC_DETAIL_CONSTEXPR std::uint64_t
223MsbTableByte (std::uint64_t tableIndex, std::uint64_t poly) LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
224{
225 LUMEX_STATIC_ASSERT_MSG (Width >= kBitsPerByte,
226 "MSB table entries assume width >= 8");
227 std::uint64_t const mask = Mask<Width> ();
228 std::uint64_t const highBitMask = std::uint64_t{ 1 } << (Width - 1);
229 std::uint64_t registerValue = (tableIndex << (Width - kBitsPerByte)) & mask;
230 for (int step = 0; step < kBitsPerByte; ++step)
231 if ((registerValue & highBitMask) != 0U)
232 registerValue = ((registerValue << 1) & mask) ^ poly;
233 else
234 registerValue = (registerValue << 1) & mask;
235 return registerValue & mask;
236}
237
238template <int Width>
239LUMEX_CRC_DETAIL_CONSTEXPR std::uint64_t
240LsbTableByte (std::uint64_t tableIndex, std::uint64_t poly) LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
241{
242 std::uint64_t const mask = Mask<Width> ();
243 std::uint64_t const reflectedPoly = Reflect (poly, Width) & mask;
244 std::uint64_t registerValue = tableIndex;
245 for (int step = 0; step < kBitsPerByte; ++step)
246 if ((registerValue & 1U) != 0U)
247 registerValue = (registerValue >> 1) ^ reflectedPoly;
248 else
249 registerValue >>= 1;
250 return registerValue & mask;
251}
252
253// NOLINTEND(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters)
254
255// C++14: non-const std::array::operator[]/at are not constexpr; build the
256// table via index_sequence
257// and aggregate initialization instead of a mutating loop inside
258// constexpr MakeLookupTable.
259#if __cplusplus >= 201402L
260template <typename Spec, std::size_t Index>
261LUMEX_CONSTEXPR_FUNCTION std::uint64_t
262LookupTableEntry () LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
263{
264 return Spec::kRefIn
265 ? LsbTableByte<Spec::kWidth> (static_cast<std::uint64_t> (Index),
266 Spec::kPoly)
267 : MsbTableByte<Spec::kWidth> (static_cast<std::uint64_t> (Index),
268 Spec::kPoly);
269}
270
271template <typename Spec, std::size_t... I>
272LUMEX_CONSTEXPR_FUNCTION std::array<std::uint64_t, kTableByteCount>
273MakeLookupTableImpl (std::index_sequence<I...>) LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
274{
275 return std::array<std::uint64_t, kTableByteCount>{
276 { LookupTableEntry<Spec, I> ()... }
277 };
278}
279#endif
280
281template <typename Spec>
282LUMEX_CRC_DETAIL_CONSTEXPR std::array<std::uint64_t, kTableByteCount>
283MakeLookupTable () LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
284{
285 ValidateSpec<Spec> ();
286#if __cplusplus >= 201402L
287 return MakeLookupTableImpl<Spec> (
288 std::make_index_sequence<kTableByteCount>{});
289#else
290 std::array<std::uint64_t, kTableByteCount> lookupTable{};
291 for (int tableIndex = 0; tableIndex < static_cast<int> (kTableByteCount);
292 ++tableIndex)
293 {
294 std::size_t const entry = static_cast<std::size_t> (tableIndex);
295 LUMEX_CONSTEXPR_IF (Spec::kRefIn)
296 LUMEX_CRC_ARRAY_REF (lookupTable, entry) = LsbTableByte<Spec::kWidth> (
297 static_cast<std::uint64_t> (tableIndex), Spec::kPoly);
298 else LUMEX_CRC_ARRAY_REF (lookupTable, entry)
299 = MsbTableByte<Spec::kWidth> (
300 static_cast<std::uint64_t> (tableIndex), Spec::kPoly);
301 }
302 return lookupTable;
303#endif
304}

306template <typename Spec>
307LUMEX_CRC_DETAIL_CONSTEXPR typename Spec::ValueType
308ComputeBitwise (std::uint8_t const *data, std::size_t size) LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
309{
310 ValidateSpec<Spec> ();
311 std::uint64_t const mask = Mask<Spec::kWidth> ();
312 std::uint64_t const polyMasked = Spec::kPoly & mask;
313 std::uint64_t const polyReflected
314 = Reflect (polyMasked, Spec::kWidth) & mask;
315 std::uint64_t crcRegister
316 = (Spec::kRefIn ? Reflect (Spec::kInit, Spec::kWidth) : Spec::kInit)
317 & mask;
318
319 if (data == nullptr || size == 0UL)
320 return static_cast<typename Spec::ValueType> (0);
321
322 // NOLINTBEGIN(cppcoreguidelines-pro-bounds-pointer-arithmetic)
323 for (std::size_t offset = 0; offset < size; ++offset)
324 {
325 std::uint8_t const messageByte = data[offset];
326 LUMEX_CONSTEXPR_IF (Spec::kRefIn)
327 {
328 for (int bitIndex = 0; bitIndex < kBitsPerByte; ++bitIndex)
329 {
330 std::uint8_t const dataBit = static_cast<std::uint8_t> (
331 (static_cast<unsigned> (messageByte) >> bitIndex) & 1U);
332 crcRegister ^= static_cast<std::uint64_t> (dataBit);
333 if ((crcRegister & 1U) != 0U)
334 crcRegister = (crcRegister >> 1) ^ polyReflected;
335 else
336 crcRegister >>= 1;
337 crcRegister &= mask;
338 }
339 }
340 else
341 {
342 int const msbShiftIndex = Spec::kWidth - 1;
343 for (int bitIndex = 0; bitIndex < kBitsPerByte; ++bitIndex)
344 {
345 std::uint8_t const dataBit = static_cast<std::uint8_t> (
346 (static_cast<unsigned> (messageByte)
347 >> (kBitsPerByte - 1 - bitIndex))
348 & 1U);
349 std::uint64_t const topBit = (crcRegister >> msbShiftIndex) & 1U;
350 crcRegister = (crcRegister << 1) & mask;
351 if ((topBit ^ static_cast<std::uint64_t> (dataBit)) != 0U)
352 crcRegister ^= polyMasked;
353 }
354 }
355 }
356 // NOLINTEND(cppcoreguidelines-pro-bounds-pointer-arithmetic)
357
358 // RefIn=true: same as zlib / RevEng tables - no final Reflect before xorout.
359 LUMEX_CONSTEXPR_IF (!Spec::kRefIn && Spec::kRefOut)
360 crcRegister = Reflect (crcRegister, Spec::kWidth) & mask;
361 crcRegister = (crcRegister ^ Spec::kXorOut) & mask;
362 return static_cast<typename Spec::ValueType> (crcRegister);
363}
364
365template <typename Spec>
366LUMEX_CRC_DETAIL_CONSTEXPR typename Spec::ValueType
367ComputeTableDriven (std::uint8_t const *data, std::size_t size) LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
368{
369 ValidateSpec<Spec> ();
370#if __cplusplus >= 201402L
371 LUMEX_CONSTEXPR std::array<std::uint64_t, kTableByteCount> kByteLookupTable
372 = MakeLookupTable<Spec> ();
373#else
374 static std::array<std::uint64_t, kTableByteCount> const kByteLookupTable
375 = MakeLookupTable<Spec> ();
376#endif
377 std::uint64_t const mask = Mask<Spec::kWidth> ();
378 std::uint64_t crcRegister
379 = (Spec::kRefIn ? Reflect (Spec::kInit, Spec::kWidth) : Spec::kInit)
380 & mask;
381
382 if (data == nullptr || size == 0UL)
383 return static_cast<typename Spec::ValueType> (0);
384
385 // NOLINTBEGIN(cppcoreguidelines-pro-bounds-pointer-arithmetic)
386 LUMEX_CONSTEXPR_IF (Spec::kRefIn)
387 {
388 for (std::size_t offset = 0; offset < size; ++offset)
389 {
390 std::uint8_t const messageByte = data[offset];
391 crcRegister
392 = (crcRegister >> kBitsPerByte)
393 ^ LUMEX_CRC_ARRAY_REF (
394 kByteLookupTable,
395 (crcRegister ^ static_cast<std::uint64_t> (messageByte))
396 & kByteMaskU8);
397 crcRegister &= mask;
398 }
399 }
400 else
401 {
402 for (std::size_t offset = 0; offset < size; ++offset)
403 {
404 std::uint8_t const messageByte = data[offset];
405 crcRegister = ((crcRegister << kBitsPerByte) & mask)
406 ^ LUMEX_CRC_ARRAY_REF (
407 kByteLookupTable,
408 ((crcRegister >> (Spec::kWidth - kBitsPerByte))
409 ^ static_cast<std::uint64_t> (messageByte))
410 & kByteMaskU8);
411 crcRegister &= mask;
412 }
413 LUMEX_CONSTEXPR_IF (Spec::kRefOut)
414 crcRegister = Reflect (crcRegister, Spec::kWidth) & mask;
415 }
416 // NOLINTEND(cppcoreguidelines-pro-bounds-pointer-arithmetic)
417
418 crcRegister = (crcRegister ^ Spec::kXorOut) & mask;
419 return static_cast<typename Spec::ValueType> (crcRegister);
420}

422template <typename Spec, typename Enable = void> struct crc_dispatch_t;
423
425// Hidden from Doxygen: it reads the comparisons in the template arguments
426// of these partial specializations as angle brackets.
427template <typename Spec>
428struct crc_dispatch_t<
429 Spec, typename std::enable_if<(Spec::kWidth < kBitsPerByte), void>::type>
430{
431 static LUMEX_CRC_DETAIL_CONSTEXPR typename Spec::ValueType
432 Run (std::uint8_t const *data, std::size_t size) LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
433 {
434 return ComputeBitwise<Spec> (data, size);
435 }
436};
437
438template <typename Spec>
439struct crc_dispatch_t<
440 Spec, typename std::enable_if<(Spec::kWidth >= kBitsPerByte), void>::type>
441{
442 static LUMEX_CRC_DETAIL_CONSTEXPR typename Spec::ValueType
443 Run (std::uint8_t const *data, std::size_t size) LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
444 {
445 return ComputeTableDriven<Spec> (data, size);
446 }
447};
449
450template <typename Spec>
451LUMEX_CRC_DETAIL_CONSTEXPR typename Spec::ValueType
452Compute (std::uint8_t const *data, std::size_t size) LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
453{
454 return crc_dispatch_t<Spec>::Run (data, size);
455}

2451template <typename Spec> class CrcParametric
2452{
2453public:
2454 using ValueType = typename Spec::ValueType;
2455
2456 CrcParametric () = delete;
2457 CrcParametric (CrcParametric const &) = delete;
2458 CrcParametric (CrcParametric &&) = delete;
2459 CrcParametric &operator= (CrcParametric const &) = delete;
2460 CrcParametric &operator= (CrcParametric &&) = delete;
2461 ~CrcParametric () = default;
2462
2467 LUMEX_ATTRIBUTE_NODISCARD (
2468 "CRC result is required for integrity verification.")
2469 static ValueType
2470 calculate (std::uint8_t const *data, std::size_t size) LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
2471 {
2472 return Detail::Compute<Spec> (data, size);
2473 }
2474
2475 LUMEX_ATTRIBUTE_NODISCARD (
2476 "CRC result is required for integrity verification.")
2477 static ValueType
2478 calculate (std::vector<std::uint8_t> const &data) LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
2479 {
2480 if (data.empty ())
2481 return Detail::Compute<Spec> (nullptr, 0);
2482 return Detail::Compute<Spec> (data.data (), data.size ());
2483 }
2484
2485#if LUMEX_HAS_STD_SPAN
2486 LUMEX_ATTRIBUTE_NODISCARD (
2487 "CRC result is required for integrity verification.")
2488 static ValueType
2489 calculate (std::span<std::uint8_t const> data) LUMEX_NOEXCEPT
2490 {
2491 return Detail::Compute<Spec> (data.data (), data.size ());
2492 }
2493#endif
2494};
